newsitem.title: DENMARK: Svenska Handelsbanken sees lower Danish 1997 CPI.
newsitem.headline: Svenska Handelsbanken sees lower Danish 1997 CPI.

text.p: In its latest survey U.S. Sweden's Svenska Handelsbanken on Friday lowered its forecast for Denmark's 1997 inflation to 2.1 percent from 2.5 percent in its last forecast in February.
At the same time it left its estimate for GDP (gross domestic product) growth unchanged at 3.5 percent and forecast a 1997 current account surplus of 10.0 billion crowns.
The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in May foresaw 3.3 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 7.8 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 12.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations in recent months.
